title: Shadow of Rome (Shadow of Rome Recompiled)
description: Unofficial PC port of Shadow of Rome (PS2), made by static recompilation with PS2Recomp. Drawn by the video card with PCSX2's GS, VU1 by PCSX2's microVU: smooth 60 FPS, up to 8x, 16:9 and 21:9, wider field of view. Chapter 1 played to the end. Languages: English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, an
